title: Goldman Sachs raises India's CY26 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%, cuts inflation, CAD estimates
description: Goldman Sachs raises its CY26 real GDP growth forecast for India by 0.3pp to 6.8% y-o-y, lowers headline inflation forecast by 0.2pp to 4.4% y-o-y and current account deficit forecast by 0.2pp to 1.1% of GDP
